name: Hi, I'm Matt.
tagline: markets, models, and the math underneath
bio:
I work in finance across FP&A, M&A, and investment management, with a focus on macroeconomic structure. Most of what I do comes down to one thing: building the model that turns a market shift into a decision someone can actually act on.

I build financial models for technology companies — DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, IRR, ARR, and three-statement models. The work has spanned [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com), [OpenAI](https://openai.com), Scale AI, Microsoft, Apple, Google, Hims, Nvidia, Palantir, and Astranis, grounded in market share trajectory, capex and opex structure, and margin analysis.

Before that I ran variance analysis across portfolios, ETFs, and REITs, evaluating DSCR, land valuation, and occupancy rates to underwrite IRR. I also co-founded a private real estate investment partnership under [SEC Rule 506(b)](https://www.sec.gov/smallbusiness/exemptofferings/rule506b), sourcing deals by screening for declining occupancy and elevated default risk against upside potential — which meant living with the outcomes of my own analysis rather than handing a model to someone else.

I grew up in Indiana and still live in Carmel. I work in Python, SQL, MATLAB, and Excel, with Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv Eikon, Argus, Yardi, and SEI Archway.

What I write here is mostly me pulling apart a company's public filings to see whether the story management tells matches the numbers underneath. Sometimes it does.
